question: Which objects associated with the two Pracaṇḍas must be worshipped after the previous step?
premises: There are two Pracaṇḍas connected to the sun.
Their staffs are objects of ritual attention.
inference: Afterwards, one should worship the two staffs of the two Pracaṇḍas of the sun.
uncertainties: The exact identity or iconography of the two Pracaṇḍas is not specified here.
plain_english: Afterwards, one should worship the two staffs of the two Pracaṇḍas of the sun.
